verdict_A_mapping_accuracy.verdict: MOSTLY ACCURATE WITH ONE MATERIAL PATCH CORRECTION
findings: The 20 positional entries EXT-F-4150 through EXT-F-4169 map to canonical inventory feature positions 185 through 204 and current generated catalog indices 147 through 166. Each exact tool name aligns with the current generated catalog. The canonical inventory's catalog_record_index values are one greater across these rows; `wait_for` also has the earlier catalog row at index 57, while EXT-F-4156 maps to index 153.

The corrected census correctly treats live binding and surface-default data as current canonical database metadata. It reports 84 chrome-extension binding rows / names, 81 active definition-binding pairs, 3 inactive pairs, and 80 active names per listed surface. It correctly separates those facts from request advertisement, role access, permission outcomes, execution, and acceptance.

The source-absent fetch_url_as_markdown mapping is directionally accurate: its handler/import/category/catalog path is absent, the generated catalog has no row, and the census records its DB definition and binding inactive. However, the proposed source status `source-absent/retired-executor`, and any interpretation that this establishes retirement or not-applicable status, goes beyond the evidence. Keep EXT-F-4149 and C01/T01 stable; record the source absence and current-build non-runnability while leaving applicability, replacement, owner intent, and retirement unresolved. Preserve the runtime cells as unverified.

EXT-F-4130 `records` remains a distinct server/manual route with current source anchors and both surfaces include the name. Preserve it rather than treating absence from the client catalog as deletion.

EXT-F-4058 and EXT-F-4156 are distinct stable `wait_for` feature IDs. The current catalog has two same-name rows at indices 57 and 153; the canonical inventory maps the former to 57 and the latter to 154 as reported. Preserve both IDs and their respective mapping.

verdict_B_scope_and_quality.verdict: GOOD BOUNDED EVIDENCE; KEEP PATCH SOURCE-ONLY AND STATUS-CAUTIOUS
findings: The current-source reconciliation explicitly limits itself to the changed-path diff and does not claim a complete inventory audit or runtime verification. Its mappings for saved Network ownership, Debug download, agenda alarm behavior, Onbox AI, tab_groups collapsed forwarding, and shared scrape comments are scoped to existing features and controls.

For EXT-F-2002-C06, the source label names only accept/gated/dead-link/retry while the shared verdict options contain six choices. The catalog verifies stable EXT-F-2002-C14 through C19 mappings: accept_as_is, gated, dead_link, retry, content_mismatch, ignored. `retry` is conditional on a prior attempt. Expand C06's aggregate label to describe all six choices; retain C06 and C14-C19 without creating duplicate controls or IDs.

The source-only proposals correctly leave C08 and C10 as owner-intent unresolved and do not turn missing source observations into product-omission claims. They also correctly avoid runtime or role-visibility conclusions.

The census source hashes for docs/stabilization/inventory.json, types/tool-catalog.json, src/lib/tools/catalog.ts, src/lib/tools/registry.ts, and src/lib/tools/server-catalog.ts match the files at review. The canonical inventory digest also matches. The report's query provenance is documented as read-only and narrowly selected; this review validates its internal scope and source metadata, but does not independently replay the private database query.
